title: «Estrella de Plata», The Strand Magazine, diciembre de 1892

catalog.label: «Estrella de Plata», The Strand Magazine, vol. IV (diciembre de 1892)

parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes XIII\. — Estrella de Plata {{#ir e:holmes q:ir|—Me temo, Watson, que tendré que ir —dijo [[holmes|Holmes]] una mañana, cuando nos sentábamos juntos a desayunar.}} —¡Ir! ¿Adónde? {{#dartmoor e:holmes p:dartmoor q:dartmoor|—A [[dartmoor|Dartmoor]]; a [[kings_pyland|King's Pyland]].}} No me sorprendió. {{#extraordinario q:extraordinario|A decir verdad, lo único que me extrañaba era que no se hubiera visto ya envuelto en aquel caso extraordinario, que era el único tema de conversación a lo largo y a lo ancho de Inglaterra.}} {{#tabaco e:holmes q:tabaco|Durante un día entero mi compañero había rondado por el cuarto con el mentón sobre el pecho y el ceño fruncido, cargando y volviendo a cargar la [[pipa|pipa]] con el tabaco negro más fuerte}}, sordo por completo a mis preguntas y comentarios. {{#favorito e:estrella_de_plata q:favorito|Solo había un problema ante el público capaz de desafiar su capacidad de análisis: la singular desaparición del favorito de la [[copa_de_wessex|Copa de Wessex]] y el trágico asesinato de su entrenador.}} {{#tren e:holmes q:tren|—Creo que tenemos el tiempo justo para tomar nuestro tren en [[paddington|Paddington]], y por el camino le contaré más del asunto.}} Me haría usted un gran favor si trajera sus excelentes prismáticos.

src_en.ir: I am afraid, Watson, that I shall have to go,” said Holmes, as we sat down together to our breakfast one morning.
src_en.extraordinario: Indeed, my only wonder was that he had not already been mixed up in this extraordinary case, which was the one topic of conversation through the length and breadth of England.
src_en.tabaco: For a whole day my companion had rambled about the room with his chin upon his chest and his brows knitted, charging and recharging his pipe with the strongest black tobacco
src_en.favorito: There was but one problem before the public which could challenge his powers of analysis, and that was the singular disappearance of the favourite for the Wessex Cup, and the tragic murder of its trainer.
src_en.tren: We have, I think, just time to catch our train at Paddington, and I will go further into the matter upon our journey.
src_en.ovejas: You have a few sheep in the paddock,” he said.
src_en.raro: Have you noticed anything amiss with them of late?
src_en.cojas: Well, sir, not of much account; but three of them have gone lame, sir.
src_en.complacido: I could see that Holmes was extremely pleased, for he chuckled and rubbed his hands together.
src_en.tiro_largo: A long shot, Watson; a very long shot,” said he, pinching my arm.
src_en.ross: Colonel Ross still wore an expression which showed the poor opinion which he had formed of my companion's ability, but I saw by the Inspector's face that his attention had been keenly aroused.
src_en.perro: To the curious incident of the dog in the night-time.
src_en.incidente: That was the curious incident,” remarked Sherlock Holmes.
